news.pageIntro: A curated record of approved Grand Theft Auto VI announcements and game information.

launch.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026
launch.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.
launch.content: Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games lists Vice City and the wider state of Leonida as the setting for the game.

preorder.title: Pre-Order Grand Theft Auto VI on June 25
preorder.summary: Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI begin June 25, 2026.
preorder.content: Rockstar Games announced that pre-orders begin June 25, 2026. Digital versions can begin pre-loading on November 12 ahead of launch on November 19.

extended.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look — Now Playing
extended.summary: The official Extended Look is now available to watch.
extended.content: Rockstar Games released An Extended Look on August 27, 2026. The official media hub lists it as the latest long-form video release.

dualsense.title: First look at the Grand Theft Auto VI Limited Edition DualSense wireless controller
dualsense.summary: PlayStation revealed a limited edition DualSense wireless controller themed around Grand Theft Auto VI.
dualsense.content: PlayStation revealed a Grand Theft Auto VI Limited Edition DualSense wireless controller on September 3, 2026. This article records the public announcement without adding unconfirmed availability or pricing details.

platforms.title: Grand Theft Auto VI platforms and editions
platforms.summary: Rockstar Games confirms PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the launch platforms.
platforms.content: Grand Theft Auto VI is announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The official product information also distinguishes the Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition. This companion does not add unsupported future platforms or pricing.
